areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Direct, central fit: intermodal mobility, green areas and urban integration are the core scope, SMART indicators, most resources, high impact though not exceptional.

areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: A specific objective and components on lighting, surveillance and a municipal guard base improve the sense of safety in the area, with limited materiality.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Strong environmental content (green areas, riverside boulevard, drainage reservoirs) with quantified targets, but not the majority of resources and moderate impact within a broader urban scope.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Flood-risk reduction through reservoirs and gallery works with precise verifiable targets; resources shared with mobility and impact limited to the central area, so moderate.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Clear but non-central link: specific visitation objective and SMART visitor indicator, yet minority share of resources; high but not exceptional impact.

areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: Culture is only a complementary by-product of a mobility, drainage and green-space scope; no specific indicators and marginal resources, below minimum criteria.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Only indirect link via public and green spaces usable informally; no sport objective, indicators or meaningful resources, below minimum criteria.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Only indirect link; drainage works target flood prevention, not water-use efficiency or multiple uses; no indicators and residual resources.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Purely local intervention with no objective, indicator or resources aimed at reducing regional inequalities.
